integrated_screen_results.claim_boundary: The v89 residual compiler provides a candidate-bound, auditable multi-region governing/additive/interface/control assembly and exact consistency solve. Its present numerical model is an integrated reduced control-volume screen, not a free-boundary MHD, kinetic, full-engineering, or validation solve.

baseline_route.claim_boundary: Routing is determined only by operators, states, dimensions, boundaries, time semantics, validity domains, outputs, and evidence obligations. A route match proves executability of the declared reduced operator, not device-family feasibility.

inverse_topology.claim_boundary: Family-neutral multi-region topology compilation proves typed representability, conservation/interface consistency, and stable structural identity. It is not equilibrium, stability, transport, engineering, or experimental validation.

sentinel_results.claim_boundary: Sentinels and generated controls use one family-neutral v89 chain. A pass proves representability, reachability of the structural neighborhood, executable reduced-physics screening, scoped interval regression, and post-hard-gate minimality. Validation VVUQ, full engineering acceptance, deployability, external novelty, patentability, and FTO remain unproven.
